_comment: Page-weight ceilings: per reference page (scripts/bench/ref-pages.mjs), the most gzip and brotli bytes and requests its static request graph may have. Set to the measured value rounded up by less than 2 percent. THIS FILE ONLY EVER SHRINKS: lower a number when the page gets lighter; never raise one, never add a page to hide growth. If you are over, make the source smaller.
